verses.zh: 酒能使人亵慢，浓酒使人喧嚷；凡因酒错误的，就无智慧。
verses.kjv: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.
verses.en: Wine makes people mock and strong drink makes them loud; anyone led astray by it is not wise.

verses.zh: 王的威吓如同狮子吼叫；惹动他怒的，是自害己命。
verses.kjv: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.
verses.en: A king's anger is like a lion roaring; making him angry costs you your own life.

verses.zh: 远离纷争是人的尊荣；愚妄人都爱争闹。
verses.kjv: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.
verses.en: It is an honour to stay out of a fight, but every fool wants to argue.

verses.zh: 懒惰人因冬寒不肯耕种，到收割的时候，他必讨饭而无所得。
verses.kjv: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.
verses.en: A lazy person will not plough because it is cold, so at harvest he looks for a crop and finds nothing.

verses.zh: 人心怀藏谋略，好像深水，惟明哲人才能汲引出来。
verses.kjv: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
verses.en: The plans in a person's heart are like deep water, but someone who understands can draw them out.

verses.zh: 人多述说自己的仁慈，但忠信人谁能遇着呢？
verses.kjv: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?
verses.en: Plenty of people say how kind they are, but who can find someone you can really trust?

verses.zh: 行为纯正的义人，他的子孙是有福的！
verses.kjv: The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.
verses.en: A good person lives honestly — how happy their children are after them!

verses.zh: 王坐在审判的位上，以眼目驱散诸恶。
verses.kjv: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.
verses.en: A king sitting on the judgment seat scatters every evil with a look.

verses.zh: 谁能说，我洁净了我的心，我脱净了我的罪？
verses.kjv: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?
verses.en: Who can say, "I have kept my heart clean; I am free from wrong"?

verses.zh: 两样的法码，两样的升斗，都为耶和华所憎恶。
verses.kjv: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to the LORD.
verses.en: Two different weights and two different measures — the LORD hates them both.

verses.zh: 孩童的动作是清洁，是正直，都显明他的本性。
verses.kjv: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.
verses.en: Even a child shows what they are like by what they do, whether it is pure and right.

verses.zh: 能听的耳，能看的眼，都是耶和华所造的。
verses.kjv: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD hath made even both of them.
verses.en: Ears that hear and eyes that see — the LORD made them both.

verses.zh: 不要贪睡，免致贫穷；眼要睁开，你就吃饱。
verses.kjv: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.
verses.en: Do not love sleep or you will end up poor; keep your eyes open and you will have plenty to eat.

verses.zh: 买物的说：不好，不好；及至买去，他便自夸。
verses.kjv: It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.
verses.en: "No good, no good," says the buyer — then he goes away and boasts about his bargain.

verses.zh: 有金子和许多珍珠，惟有知识的嘴乃为贵重的珍宝。
verses.kjv: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.
verses.en: There is gold and there are many jewels, but lips that speak knowledge are the rarest treasure.

verses.zh: 谁为生人作保，就拿谁的衣服；谁为外人作保，谁就要承当。
verses.kjv: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
verses.en: Take the coat of anyone who promises to pay a stranger's debt; hold it as a pledge.

verses.zh: 以虚谎而得的食物，人觉甘甜；但后来，他的口必充满尘沙。
verses.kjv: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.
verses.en: Food got by cheating tastes sweet, but afterwards the mouth is full of grit.

verses.zh: 计谋都凭筹算立定；打仗要凭智谋。
verses.kjv: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.
verses.en: Plans succeed when you talk them over; get good advice before you go to war.

verses.zh: 往来传舌的，泄漏密事；大张嘴的，不可与他结交。
verses.kjv: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.
verses.en: A gossip gives away secrets, so have nothing to do with someone who talks too much.

verses.zh: 咒骂父母的，他的灯必灭，变为漆黑的黑暗。
verses.kjv: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.
verses.en: Whoever curses their father or mother will have their lamp go out in pitch darkness.

verses.zh: 起初速得的产业，终久却不为福。
verses.kjv: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.
verses.en: Money grabbed quickly at the start will not be a blessing in the end.

verses.zh: 你不要说，我要以恶报恶；要等候耶和华，他必拯救你。
verses.kjv: Say not thou, I will recompense evil; but wait on the LORD, and he shall save thee.
verses.en: Do not say, "I will pay back the wrong." Wait for the LORD, and he will rescue you.

verses.zh: 两样的法码为耶和华所憎恶；诡诈的天平也为不善。
verses.kjv: Divers weights are an abomination unto the LORD; and a false balance is not good.
verses.en: The LORD hates two different weights, and scales that cheat are no good either.

verses.zh: 人的脚步为耶和华所定；人岂能明白自己的路呢？
verses.kjv: Man’s goings are of the LORD; how can a man then understand his own way?
verses.en: A person's steps are decided by the LORD — so how can anyone fully understand their own way?

verses.zh: 人冒失说，这是圣物，许愿之后才查问，就是自陷网罗。
verses.kjv: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.
verses.en: It is a trap to promise something to God without thinking, and only ask questions afterwards.

verses.zh: 智慧的王簸散恶人，用碌碡滚轧他们。
verses.kjv: A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.
verses.en: A wise king sorts out bad people and runs the threshing wheel over them.

verses.zh: 人的灵是耶和华的灯，鉴察人的心腹。
verses.kjv: The spirit of man is the candle of the LORD, searching all the inward parts of the belly.
verses.en: A person's spirit is the LORD's lamp, searching every corner deep inside them.

verses.zh: 王因仁慈和诚实得以保全他的国位，也因仁慈立稳。
verses.kjv: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.
verses.en: Kindness and honesty keep a king safe, and his throne is held up by kindness.

verses.zh: 强壮乃少年人的荣耀；白发为老年人的尊荣。
verses.kjv: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the gray head.
verses.en: Strength is the glory of young people, and grey hair is the honour of the old.

verses.zh: 鞭伤除净人的罪恶；责打能入人的心腹。
verses.kjv: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.
verses.en: A beating that hurts can wash away wrong, and blows reach deep inside a person.
